CCB.ConfigHint: Add custom image-based or item-backed currencies to D&D 5e actor sheets.
CCB.ConfigInstructions: Add a currency, choose its name and image, or drag an Item from a world directory or compendium onto its row to use that Item as the currency.
CCB.DropHint: Drop an Item here to make it the currency
CCB.DropItemOnly: Only Foundry Items can be used as item-backed currency.
CCB.SourceMissing: The source Item for {name} could not be found. Drag it into the configuration again.
CCB.Dnd5eOnly: Custom Currency Bar requires the D&D 5e system.
